passage.text: Last week, Nam bought a smart speaker.
passage.reading: ˈlæst ˈwiːk, ˈnɑːm ˈbɔːt ə ˈsmɑːrt ˈspiːkər.

passage.text: You can control it with your voice.
passage.reading: juː kən kənˈtroʊl ɪt wɪð jʊr ˈvɔɪs.

passage.text: "It's like a little robot!" Nam said to Emma.
passage.reading: ɪts ˈlaɪk ə ˈlɪtəl ˈroʊbɑːt! ˈnɑːm ˈsɛd tə ˈɛmə.

passage.text: On the first night, Nam said, "Play some quiet music."
passage.reading: ɑːn ðə ˈfɜːrst ˈnaɪt, ˈnɑːm ˈsɛd, ˈpleɪ sʌm ˈkwaɪət ˈmjuːzɪk.

passage.text: But the speaker played a very noisy song.
passage.reading: bʌt ðə ˈspiːkər ˈpleɪd ə ˈvɛri ˈnɔɪzi ˈsɔːŋ.

passage.text: Then she said, "Turn off the lights."
passage.reading: ˈðɛn ʃiː ˈsɛd, ˈtɜːrn ˈɔːf ðə ˈlaɪts.
ðə ˈspiːkər ˈsɛd, oʊˈkeɪ. ˈkɔːlɪŋ ˈmɑːm.

passage.text: A moment later, Nam's mom answered, "Nam? Is everything OK?"
passage.reading: ə ˈmoʊmənt ˈleɪtər, ˈnɑːmz ˈmɑːm ˈænsərd, ˈnɑːm? ɪz ˈɛvriθɪŋ oʊˈkeɪ?

passage.text: Nam laughed and explained the problem.
passage.reading: ˈnɑːm ˈlæft ənd ɪkˈspleɪnd ðə ˈprɑːbləm.

passage.text: Before bed, she said, "Wake me up at seven."
passage.reading: bɪˈfɔːr ˈbɛd, ʃiː ˈsɛd, ˈweɪk miː ˈʌp ət ˈsɛvən.

passage.text: The speaker woke her up at five!
passage.reading: ðə ˈspiːkər ˈwoʊk hɜːr ˈʌp ət ˈfaɪv!

passage.text: Now the smart speaker is in a box in her closet.
passage.reading: ˈnaʊ ðə ˈsmɑːrt ˈspiːkər ɪz ɪn ə ˈbɑːks ɪn hɜːr ˈklɑːzɪt.
